title: mri_sclimbic_seg
description: Segment subcortical limbic structures using Freesurfer.

input_file.description: T1-w image(s) to segment. Can be a path to a single image or a directory of images.
input_file.title: Input file

output_file.description: Segmentation output (required if --i is provided). Must be the same type as the input path (a single file or directory).
output_file.title: Output file

subjects.description: Process a series of freesurfer recon-all subjects (enables subject-mode).
subjects.title: Subjects

subjects_dir.description: Set the subjects directory (overrides the SUBJECTS_DIR env variable).
subjects_dir.title: Subjects directory

conform.description: Resample input to 1mm-iso; results will be put back in native resolution.
conform.title: Conform flag

etiv.description: Include eTIV in volume stats (enabled by default in subject-mode and --tal).
etiv.title: eTIV flag

exclude_labels.description: List of label IDs to exclude in any output stats files.
exclude_labels.title: Exclude labels

keep_ac.description: Explicitly keep anterior commissure in the volume/qa files.
keep_ac.title: Keep anterior commissure

vox_count_volumes.description: Use discrete voxel count for label volumes.
vox_count_volumes.title: Voxel count volumes

ctab_file.description: Alternative color lookup table to embed in segmentation. Must be minimal, including 0, and sorted.
ctab_file.title: Color table file

population_stats.description: Alternative population volume stats for QA output.
population_stats.title: Population stats file

vmp.description: Enable printing of vmpeak at the end.
vmp.title: VMP flag

threads.description: Number of threads to use. Default is 1.
threads.title: Threads

tal_xfm.description: Alternative talairach xfm transform for estimating TIV. Can be file or suffix (for multiple inputs).
tal_xfm.title: Talairach transformation

write_volumes.description: Save label volume stats (enabled by default in subject-mode).
write_volumes.title: Write volumes flag

percentile.description: Use intensity percentile threshold for normalization.
percentile.title: Percentile

output_base.description: String to use in output file name; default is sclimbic.
output_base.title: Output base

no_cite.description: Do not cite sclimbic paper at the end.
no_cite.title: No cite flag
